description.text: Battle Academy, released on 8 March 2024: a box for learning the game with four ready-built 60-card decks, led by Sprigatito ex, Pikachu ex, Lucario ex and Greninja ex, so players can switch decks from game to game. A coin, cardboard damage counters and markers, a playmat, two copies of a first-game guide to play along with (also as a video), a step-up rules guide, four deck bands, a damage counter case and a storage box with dividers came with it. The same day brought Anytime, Anywhere Battle Academy, a smaller box with only the Sprigatito ex and Pikachu ex decks, all its cards non-holo, and two half-size playmats. The cards carry the code SVI and their deck's silhouette mark.
